summary: The recorded base reproduces the observability gap on the real Axum PD chat route: successful same-host and breaker-fallback requests return HTTP 200 but emit no decode-affinity counter sample. At the exact candidate commit, the route-level regressions pass and the production path records the legacy host-affinity outcome only after a successful final selection. Independent tests confirmed exact once-per-request counting for the no-same-host fallback and confirmed that the default non-affinity decode policy does not emit a misleading affinity outcome. Plain mode and failure before decode selection remain uncounted.

tests.command: cargo test --test proxy legacy_decode_affinity_ -- --nocapture (candidate regression tests temporarily applied to recorded base)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction at 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365. Both successful PD cases returned HTTP 200 but lacked metric samples; plain mode and an empty decode pool correctly remained absent. Raw: reports/j-d45c5e2aaaed/raw/base-candidate-regression.log

At exact candidate 48a1e2bee69055ab37c8339e100ea88a7e37d598, four route tests verified same-host and breaker increments plus plain-mode and empty-decode non-recording. Raw: reports/j-d45c5e2aaaed/raw/candidate-proxy.log

gpu_execution.evidence: This is CPU-side Rust HTTP routing and Prometheus accounting. No model kernels, weights, or GPU outputs participate in the affected path; using the assigned gfx950 GPU would not strengthen this contract test.

remaining_limitations: Validation used deterministic in-process mock prefill/decode workers, not a live weighted model deployment; it qualifies router HTTP execution, selection, and metric accounting only.
No multi-node or distributed deployment was exercised.
The host is x86_64 Linux and no GPU was used. The candidate changes Rust router source only, so Python/native-extension import validation and FlyDSL rebuilds are not applicable.

The image-prepared Cargo path was unreadable to the assigned user; the repository-pinned Rust 1.90 toolchain and rustfmt were installed in /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-d45c5e2aaaed and all candidate tests compiled against /job/repo/experimental/sgl-router with CARGO_TARGET_DIR outside the checkout.
